S.FORM: == babaledaw == 擬稻蝗/ sa lebulebud ku babaledaw i umaumahan. siwkay nu babaledaw u kulit nu babaledaw a kidu sa, u landaway atu makulahay . sapilimet i liwliw , u midiputay a kulit 保護色. mukan tu nipaluma' ku babaledaw, sisa mabidang ku malukay tu babaledaw. itawya, tuduhen ikiken nu malukay ku babaledaw, bangsis a'su tu. hali mukan tu niyazu'ay a tademaw. mibabaledaw 抓蝗蟲/ mibabaledaw kaku i umaumahan nacila. sibabaledawan 有蝗蟲的地方/ sibabaledaw ku umah ni Kacaw. u sulit nu Amilika Locusts are certain species of short-horned grasshoppers in the family Acrididae that have a swarming phase. These insects are usually solitary, but under certain circumstances, become more abundant and change their behaviour and habits, becoming gregarious. No taxonomic distinction is made between locust and grasshopper species; the basis for the definition is whether a species forms swarms under intermittently suitable conditions.
S.PHON: baba[r|ɾ]ədaw *** sa [r|ɾ]əbu[r|ɾ]əbud ku baba[r|ɾ]ədaw i umaumaħan siwkaj nu baba[r|ɾ]ədaw u ku[r|ɾ]it nu baba[r|ɾ]ədaw a kidu sa u [r|ɾ]andawaj atu maku[r|ɾ]aħaj sapi[r|ɾ]imət i [r|ɾ]iw[r|ɾ]iw u midiputaj a ku[r|ɾ]it *** mukan tu nipa[r|ɾ]uma[ʔ|ʡ] ku baba[r|ɾ]ədaw sisa mabidaŋ ku ma[r|ɾ]ukaj tu baba[r|ɾ]ədaw itawja tuduħən ikikən nu ma[r|ɾ]ukaj ku baba[r|ɾ]ədaw baŋsis a[ʔ|ʡ]su tu ħa[r|ɾ]i mukan tu nijazu[ʔ|ʡ]aj a tadəmaw mibaba[r|ɾ]ədaw *** mibaba[r|ɾ]ədaw kaku i umaumaħan naʦi[r|ɾ]a sibaba[r|ɾ]ədawan ****** sibaba[r|ɾ]ədaw ku umaħ ni kaʦaw u su[r|ɾ]it nu ami[r|ɾ]ika [r|ɾ]oʦusts arə ʦərtain spəʦiəs of sħortħornəd grassħoppərs in tħə fami[r|ɾ]j aʦrididaə tħat ħa*ə a swarmiŋ pħasə tħəsə insəʦts arə usua[r|ɾ][r|ɾ]j so[r|ɾ]itarj but undər ʦərtain ʦirʦumstanʦəs bəʦomə morə abundant and ʦħaŋə tħəir bəħa*iour and ħabits bəʦomiŋ grəgarious no ta*onomiʦ distinʦtion is madə bətwəən [r|ɾ]oʦust and grassħoppər spəʦiəs tħə basis for tħə dəfinition is wħətħər a spəʦiəs forms swarms undər intərmittənt[r|ɾ]j suitab[r|ɾ]ə ʦonditions
